chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked about a man whose home is beyond al-Juhfah: from where should he enter into ihram?

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.يُحْرِمُ: enters into the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: From where should a person living beyond al-Juhfah assume ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the miqat for a person whose residence lies beyond al-Juhfah. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that such a person enters ihram from his own home, clarifying the ruling for hajj-related travel.
